input.body:
From: Varan Shipping - Operation Dept. <operation@varanshipping.com> 
Sent: Thursday, 13 July 2017 14:25
To: chartering <chartering@etm-services.net>
Cc: ETMS Management <management@etm-services.net>; director@etm-services.net
Subject: MV STAD, TRIGNMOUTH // ALEXANDRIA TERMS

 

Dear Mohamed / Elif

 

Good day,

 

Please find atatched chrtrs full terms a/e as fllws for 30 mins;

 

MV STAD

SID, BOX, 1989 BLT

DOUBLE SKINNED, STEEL FLOORED

DWT/DWCC 3222/3050 MT

VANUATU FLAG

LOA/BEAM/DRAFT/DM 89,21/12,5M/4,70/6,35M

1 HO/HA BOX, 1 BULKHEAD ,OPENHATCH

HO 63,00 X 10,05 X 6,17MTRS

GRAIN 140,000CBFT

GRT/NRT 1984/1056

IR CLASS, P & I LODESTAR

APP B FITTED, GLESS

BOWTHRUST YES

ADA WOG

 

Itinerary ; she is proceeding to Bayonne for discharging with eta 16th July
2017 noon time. Etb upon arrival 

Etc/s 18th july morning hrs wp.

She will load same port on 19th july morning and etc/s same day noon time

Eta to Cardiff for discharging 22th july wp

Etc/s 24th july pm hrs wp.

One day steaming to Teingmouth, which means eta to load port 25th July pm
hrs wp.

 

 

PLEASE ADVISE:

 

OWNERS/MANAGERS/DISP OWNERS:

BANKING DETAILS FOR FRT REMITTANCE: 

FULL DESCRIPTION OF THE VESSEL:

PLS PROVIDE VALID  CLASS + P&I  + ISM + REGISRTY  CERTIFICATES 

 

-suitable to load the cgo she has been fixed for with all valid certificates
on board including: memo of Paris cargo securing manual/trim and
stability/bulk loading manual(booklet)certificate according to solas ch vi
part b reg.7(2)/ vessel to be fully suitable and fully fitted to load
present cargo owners guarantee that the vessel is fully suitable and fully
fitted for shipment of the cargo she has been fixed for and that all
pertaining international certificates are on board. also owners guarantee
that the vessel is suitable for grab loading/discharge and that all the
spaces are accessible for bulk cargo and for grab loading/discharge.

-vsl to be in possession of approved grain/bulk cargo loading plan in
accordance with local and international regulations.

-vsl to be in possession of all the required documentation to pass
successfully the ordinary stability calculation/inspection by local harbour
master office.

-from the date of coming into force of the international safety management

(ism) code in relation to the vessel and thereafter during the currency of
this c/p, the owners shall procure that both the vessel and '' the
company'' ( as defined by the ism code) shall comply with the requirements
of the ism code.

upon request the owners shall provide a copy of the relevant document of
compliance (doc) and safety managment certificate (smc) to the charterers.

except as

otherwise provided in this c/p, loss, damage, expense or    delay caused by
failure on the part of the owners or '' the company ''  to comply with the
ism code shall be for the owners' account.

-from the date of coming into force of the international code for the
security of ships and of port facilities and the relevant amendments to
chapter xi of solas (isps code) in relation to the vessel, the owners shall
procure that both the vessel and "the company" (as defined by the isps

code) shall comply with the requirements of the isps code relating to the
vessel and "the company".

 

FOR:

 

-SUB SHIPPERS/RECEIVERS/UNDERWRITTERS APPROVAL TO BE LIFTED W/I  24 HRS
-CHARTERERS  : 

 

- ACCT:  LEPRO TRADE LP  IRELAND

- LAST FIXTURES  MV JAZZ,MV NAJVA,MV CRYSTAL GALAXY ,MV  MARGARET, MV AVRA

 

- LOADING PORT  :   TEIGNMOUTH , UK 1GSPB AAAA

- DISCHARGE  PORT : ALEXANDRIA  1 SB  AA  OR 1 SAFE ANCHORAGE ( port
authorities will decide about berth discharge or anchorage discharge 24
hours prior vessel arrival during harbor master meeting.

if discharge is at anchorage same will be into barges which will be
alongside the vessel. ) 

-OWNERS STATISY THIER SELVES WITH RESTIRCTIONS OF THE PORTS BENDS.

-OWNERS GUARANTEE

-IF A SECOND BERTH USED, SHIFTING WILL BE FOR CHRTS ACCNT BENDS.

-LAYCAN: 25/28  TH  JULY 2017

-CARGO  :  3000 MTS CLAY IN BULK STW/DWT 

-OWNERS GUARANT THAT DWCC OF THE VESSEL IS 3050 MTS

-FREIGHT: EURO 30 PMT FIOST FREIGHT FULLY PAID  WITHIN 5 BD FM S/R BS/L
ANYCASE MKD''FREIGHT PAYBALE AS PER CP'', IF CHRTRS REQUIRE BSL MKD 'FREIGHT
PAYABLE AT DESTINATION  ' MASTER TO SIGN BSL ACCORDINGLY AND SAME TO REMAIN
IN HANDS OF AGENTS  UNTILL CHARTERES HAVE DULY REMITTED FULL FREIGHT AND
PROVIDE IRREVOCABLY SWIFT COPY 

-SEA FREIGHT CAN BE PAID BY CHRTRS GUARANTEED AGENT.

-IN CASE ORIGINAL BS/L NOT AVAILABLE AT DISCH PORT OWS AGREE TO DELIVER CGO
AGAINST  PRESENTATION OF L.O.I ISSUED AND SIGNED BY CHRTS 

-FREIGHT EARNED ON SIGNING BS/L DISCOUNTLESS AND NON RETURNABLE SHIP AND OR
CGO LOST OR NOT LOST

-NOTICES: 3 APPROXIMATE NOTICE ON FIXING AND 3/2/1 DAYS DEFINITE NOTICE 

-LOADING/DISCH  5  TTL  WWDAYS OF 24 CONSEC HOURS SSHEX/TFHEX AT LOADING
PORT TIME FROM FRIDAY 5 PM OR 5 PM ON A DAY PRECEEDING A  HOLIDAY TILL  8 AM
ON MONDAY    OR 8 AM ON NEXT WORKING DAY NOT TO COUNT  EIU.

AT DISCHARGING PORT TIME FROM THURSDAY 12 PM OR 5 PM ON A DAY PRECEEDING A
HOLIDAY TILL 8 AM ON SATURDAY  OR 8 AM ON NEXT WORKING DAY NOT TO COUNT EIU.

-CARGO TO BE LOADED AND DISCHARGED BOTH ENDS BY DRAFT DURVEY.

- IF SHIPPERS /CHARTERERS TO HAVE SEVERAL GRADES TO BE  SEPERATED BY
TRAPOULINS HOLD 

-TIME LOST IN WAITING FOR BERTH AT LOADING/DISCH TO COUNT AS LAYTIME
W/W/W/W AND WITHIN TERMS, PROVISIONS, EXCEPTIONS OF THIS C/P.

-MASTER HAS THE RIGHT TO GIVE N.O.R. BY RADIO OR CABLE. 

-LAYTIME FOR  LOADING AND DISCHARGING SHALL ANYCASE COMMENCE 08/14 CLS BENDS


-'CLEAN ON BOARD' BS/L PROVIDED CGO IN CONFORMITY.  IF CLEAN ON BOARD BLS
REQIRED,  MASTER HAS RIGHT TO REJECET UNSOUND, UNCLEAN CARGO AND REPLACE
WITH SOUND ONE AT CHTRS TIME AND EXPENSES.CLEAN BLS SHALL BE SIGNED FOR
CLEAN CARGO ONLY.

-TIME USED BEFORE COMMENCEMENTD B OF LAYTIME SHALL NOT COUNT EIU  -SHORE
CRANES BOTH ENDS TO BE SUPPLIED BY CHRTS AND AT THEIR ACCOUNT 

-CARGO TO BE LOADED AND DISCHARGED BY DRAFT  SURVEY BOTH ENDS.

-   IF  QUANTITY  DETERMINED BY   SHORE SCALE  FOLLOWING  TERMS  TO BE
APPLIED.  IF  DRAFT SURVEY  TO BE USED THAT OWNERS  SHALL  BE RESPONSIBLE
FOR THE  DRAFT SURVEY  REPORT ONLY.   TO BE LOADED BY SHIPPERS  DRAFT SURVEY
.AFTER LOADING IS COMPLETE, HOLDS TO BE SEALED BY SHIPPERS OR SURVEYORS FOR
THEIR TIME/ACCOUNT. 

AT LOADING PORT CHRTS' SURVEYOR TO ISSUE THE SEALING  CERTIFICATE, WHICH TO
BE SIGNED BY MASTER AND SHIPPERS OR SURVEYORS IN  CHOPT.

IF THE SEALS PRESENTED TO RECEIVERS'REPRESENTATIVE OR CHRTS'AGENTS AT
DISCH/PORT PRIOR TO THE COMMENCEMENT OF DISCHARGING ARE FOUND INTACT, AND IS
CONFIRMED BY THE RELEVANT SEAL AND SIGNATURE, THEN MASTER/OWNERS ARE NOT
RESPONSIBLE FOR POSSIBLE WEIGHT SHORTAGE AT DISCH/PORT, AND THEREFORE ALL
SHORATAGE CLAIMS SHALL SETTLED BTWN CHRTS AND RECEIVERS DIRECTLY

-DEMURRAGE: 1500 .- EURO PDPR FD

DEMURRAGE PAYABLE WITH IN 10 DAYS BY THE CHRTRS AFTER PRESENTATION OF S/F
DULY SIGNED BY THE MASTER AND AGENT AT LOADING/DISCH PORTS AND OWNERS T/S +
INVOICE -USUAL DELETIONS OF GENCON SUCH AS 'TEN RUNNING DAYS ON' 'PAYABLE
DAY BY DAY' 'DAMAGES FOR DETENTIONS' (3TIMES) DELETE LINES 97/98/99 DELETE
CL 4/5/6 

-ONCE ON DEMURRAGE ALWAYS ON DEMURRAGE 

-LAYTIME TO COUNT TILL COMPLETION OF LOADING.CHTRS HAVE FREE 3 HOURS FOR
CARGO  DOCUMENTS PREPARATION WHICH ARE NOT COUNTED AS LAYTIME. ANY EXTRA
TIME  TO COUNT AS LAYTIME.

-TAXES DUES ON CGO CHRTRS ACCT

-TAXES DUES ON VSL AND OR FREIGHT OWS ACCT

- VESSEL IS FREE OF EXTRA INSURANCEON CARGO DUE TO AGE, CLASS AND FLAG
-DRAFT BLS TO BE PRESENTED FOR OWNERS APPROVAL 

-BILLS  OF LADING   WILL BE     "  CHINA CLAY  ASSOCIATION   APPROVED FORM
OF BILL OF LADING  adopted 27 th january   1908 " 

-VSL TO HAVE HOLDS CLEAN AND DRY PRIOR LOADING -ARBITRATION IF ANY IN LONDON
ACCORDING TO THE ENGLISH LAW 

-ANY CLAIMS UPTO 20.000 USD TO BE SETTLED IN LONDON UNDER THE LMAA SMALL
CLAIM PROCEDURE -G/A YORK ANTWERP AND IN LONDON 

-NEW BOTH TO BLAME COLLISION CLAUSE, NEW JASON CLAUSE, PARAMOUNT CLAUSE, WAR
RISK NO 1 AND 2 TO BE INTEGRANT PART OF THIS C/P 

-CHRTRS AGENT BENDS .

 

AT LOADING PORT  

 

PIKE WARD LIMITED

SHIP BROKERS

OLD QUAY, TEIGNMOUTH, DEVON, TQ14 8EU

Registered in England No. 205282

 

Email:   agency@pikeward.co.uk <mailto:agency@pikeward.co.uk> 

 

Tel:       +44 (0) 1626 772311

Fax:      +44 (0) 1626 770218

Mob:     +44 (0) 7860 674364

 

DISCHARGING PORT EGYPT TRADE MARITIME SERVICES  (E.T.M.S.) Fawzy Fahmy Gendy
St,

21131 El Raml Station Alexandria - Egypt

Phone: 00 20 (3) 4865320  - Fax: 00 20(3) 4872895 16,

Email: agency@etm-services.net <mailto:agency@etm-services.net> 

 

-OWISE AS PER CLEAN GENCON LAYOUT 76 C/P TO APPLY   WITH  3.75 TTL  COMS  

 

End 

 

Plsd to hear 

 

Rgrds

Eli

 

VARAN SHIPPING-CO, ISTANBUL

TEL         : +90 216 504 17 08

FAX        : +90 216 504 17 05

acknowledgement_deadline.source_text: Please find atatched chrtrs full terms a/e as fllws for 30 mins;

additional_terms: Vessel description: SID, BOX, double-skinned, steel-floored; 1 HO/HA BOX, 1 bulkhead, openhatch; HO 63.00 x 10.05 x 6.17 m; Grain 140,000 CBFT; GRT/NRT 1984/1056; IR Class; P&I: Lodestar; APP B fitted; bow thruster fitted.
ADA WOG — all details about, without guarantee.

Itinerary: Proceeding to Bayonne for discharging ETA 16 July 2017 noon, ETB on arrival, ETC/S 18 July morning WP; load same port 19 July morning, ETC/S same day noon WP; ETA Cardiff discharging 22 July WP, ETC/S 24 July PM WP; one day steaming to Teignmouth, ETA load port 25 July PM WP.
Owners requested to provide: owners/managers/disponent owners details, banking details for freight remittance, full vessel description, valid Class/P&I/ISM/Registry certificates.
Vessel suitable for grab loading/discharge; all spaces accessible for bulk cargo; holds clean and dry prior loading.
Vessel in possession of approved grain/bulk cargo loading plan per local and international regulations.
Vessel in possession of all documentation for stability calculation/inspection by local harbour master.

ISM Code compliance clause: owners to procure vessel and 'the company' comply with ISM Code; copy of DOC and SMC to be provided on request; loss/damage/expense/delay from non-compliance for owners' account.
ISPS Code compliance clause: owners to procure vessel and 'the company' comply with ISPS Code.
Last fixtures reference: MV JAZZ, MV NAJVA, MV CRYSTAL GALAXY, MV MARGARET, MV AVRA.

Discharge port: Alexandria 1 SB AA or 1 safe anchorage; port authorities will decide on berth or anchorage discharge 24 hours prior to vessel arrival during harbour master meeting; if discharge at anchorage, into barges alongside the vessel.
Owners to satisfy themselves with restrictions of the ports at both ends.
Owners guarantee DWCC of vessel is 3050 MT.
If a second berth used, shifting for charterers' account both ends.
Laytime: 5 total weather working days of 24 consecutive hours SSHEX/TFHEX EIU — combined for both loading and discharging.
Laytime to commence 08:00/14:00 CLS both ends.
Time lost waiting for berth at loading/discharge to count as laytime W/W/W/W within terms, provisions, exceptions of this C/P.
Master has right to give NOR by radio or cable.
Time used before commencement of laytime shall not count EIU.
Charterers have free 3 hours for cargo documents preparation at completion of loading, not counted as laytime; any extra time counts as laytime.
Shore cranes at both ends to be supplied by charterers at their account.
Cargo to be loaded and discharged by draft survey both ends.

If quantity determined by shore scale: specific terms to apply; if draft survey used, owners responsible for draft survey report only. Loaded by shippers' draft survey. After loading complete, holds to be sealed by shippers or surveyors at their time/account.

At loading port, charterers' surveyor to issue sealing certificate signed by master and shippers or surveyors in charterers' option. If seals found intact at discharge port prior to commencement of discharging, master/owners not responsible for possible weight shortage; all shortage claims settled between charterers and receivers directly.
If several grades, to be separated by tarpaulins in hold.
Notices: 3 approximate notices on fixing and 3/2/1 days definite notice.
Cargo loaded and discharged both ends by draft survey.
GENCON usual deletions: 'Ten running days on', 'Payable day by day', 'Damages for Detention' (3 times) — delete lines 97/98/99; delete Cl 4/5/6.
Once on demurrage, always on demurrage.
Taxes/dues on cargo for charterers' account; taxes/dues on vessel and/or freight for owners' account.
Vessel free of extra insurance on cargo due to age, class, and flag.
Draft B/L to be presented for owners' approval.
Bills of Lading: 'China Clay Association Approved Form of Bill of Lading adopted 27th January 1908'.

Clean On Board B/L provided cargo in conformity. If clean on board B/L required, master has right to reject unsound/unclean cargo and replace with sound cargo at charterers' time and expense. Clean B/L to be signed for clean cargo only.
In case original B/L not available at discharge port, owners agree to deliver cargo against presentation of LOI issued and signed by charterers.
Sea freight can be paid by charterers' guaranteed agent.
General Average: York-Antwerp Rules, in London.
New Both to Blame Collision Clause, New Jason Clause, Paramount Clause, War Risk No. 1 and 2 to be integral part of this C/P.
Charterers' agents both ends.
WIPON WIBON WIFPON WCCON — NOR tendering conditions not explicitly stated but implied by 'MASTER HAS THE RIGHT TO GIVE N.O.R. BY RADIO OR CABLE'.
STW/DWT — cargo stowage factor equals deadweight (stowage = DWT).

unknown_terms.context: Vessel description: 'APP B FITTED, GLESS' — 'APP B' not a recognized standard shipping abbreviation; may refer to Appendix B of a specific class or regulation. Requires broker verification.
Vessel classification: 'IR CLASS' — not a recognized IACS member classification society abbreviation. May refer to Iranian Register of Shipping or similar. Requires broker verification.
P&I Club reference: 'P & I LODESTAR' — not a recognized major P&I Club name. May be a lesser-known or regional P&I provider. Requires broker verification.
Discharge port clause: 'ALEXANDRIA  1 SB  AA' — 'AA' appears in place of 'AAAA' (Always Accessible Always Afloat); may be abbreviation variant or typographical error. Requires broker clarification.

Vessel dimensions: 'LOA/BEAM/DRAFT/DM 89,21/12,5M/4,70/6,35M' — 'DM' used alongside DRAFT suggesting it may mean 'Deadweight Draft' or 'Maximum Draft' but is non-standard. Requires broker clarification.

Laytime commencement: 'LAYTIME FOR LOADING AND DISCHARGING SHALL ANYCASE COMMENCE 08/14 CLS BENDS' — 'CLS' is not a recognized standard laytime abbreviation. May mean 'Close' or refer to office hours. Requires broker clarification.
Demurrage clause: 'OWNERS T/S + INVOICE' — in this context 'T/S' appears to mean 'Time Sheet' rather than 'Transhipment'. Non-standard usage in demurrage context; flagged for verification.
